title: KKKKhazix/AIHOT
why_read: A framework for building your own curated 'trending topics' news site, useful mainly if you want to run a similar digest yourself.
analysis: This is a TypeScript framework that lets you build a website that automatically finds trending topics and generates daily reports, which you can customize with your own sources and curation criteria. It's essentially a template/toolkit for building a Hacker-News-style or industry digest site rather than a novel technical breakthrough. The high star count suggests it filled a popular niche for Chinese-language developer audiences wanting to build their own tech news aggregators, but there's limited deep technical substance to highlight.
